title: ACQUISITION BY EAST USAMBARA HOLDINGS LIMITED OF INDIRECT CONTROL OF EAST USAMBARA TEA COMPANY LIMITED THROUGH ACQUISITION OF ENTIRE ISSUED SHARES IN BLUE MOUNTAIN TEA COMPANY LIMITED
title_sw: ACQUISITION BY EAST USAMBARA HOLDINGS LIMITED OF INDIRECT CONTROL OF EAST USAMBARA TEA COMPANY LIMITED THROUGH ACQUISITION OF ENTIRE ISSUED SHARES IN BLUE MOUNTAIN TEA COMPANY LIMITED
text:
East Usambara Holdings Limited notified the Fair Competition Commission (FCC) of their intention to acquire entire issued shares in Blue Mountain Tea Company, hence gaining indirect control of East Usambara Tea Company Limited. 
The relevant market was defined as the growing, processing and supply of made tea to third party tea blenders/customers in Mainland Tanzania. 
Based on the analysis it was concluded that, pre- and post-merger scenarios will remain the same for both perspectives of Section 5 (6) (a) and (b) and thus having no possibility of either creating or strengthening a position of dominance in the relevant market. The merger was approved.
